title: VoiceFeatureRecord
description: Pseudonymous voice-derived acoustic feature record. Direct identifiers (name, phone, location, device ID) must never appear in this document. Features are acoustic measurements only — not clinical interpretations.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must match the $id version.

session_id.description: Pseudonymous session identifier. Must not contain or be reversible to a direct identifier without an authorised decryption key held separately from this record. Format: sess_ followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.

language_tag.description: BCP-47 language tag for the session language (e.g., hi-IN, ta-IN, te-IN, en-IN).

feature_set_id.description: Identifier of the openSMILE feature set configuration used for extraction. Format: config filename without extension, followed by underscore and version tag.

extraction_version.description: SemVer version of the extraction pipeline that produced this record.

audio_quality.description: Audio quality assessment results from both device-side pre-screening and server-side validation.

status.description: Overall audio quality gate result. FAIL records must not be used for feature extraction or model training.

snr_db.description: Estimated signal-to-noise ratio in decibels. Null if measurement was not possible.

peak_dbfs.description: Peak level in dBFS. Values near 0 indicate clipping risk.

flags.description: List of quality warning flags (e.g., CLIPPING, LOW_LEVEL, SHORT_DURATION, HIGH_NOISE).

degraded_reason.description: Required if status is DEGRADED. Human-readable justification for using a degraded recording.

consent_reference.description: Reference to the recorded consent event authorising use of this recording. Must not be fabricated or defaulted.

consent_event_id.description: Immutable identifier of the consent event record in the consent service. Must be resolvable — not a placeholder.

permitted_purposes.description: Purposes explicitly granted by the participant. Only listed purposes are authorised for this record.

consent_version.description: Version of the consent form presented to the participant.

features.description: Map of acoustic feature name to numeric value. Feature names are openSMILE functional names — they must not be renamed to clinical labels. Null values indicate the feature could not be computed.

provenance.description: Non-identifying provenance metadata for quality and lineage tracking.

recorded_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the recording was captured.

capture_device_class.description: Class of device used for capture. Not a device identifier.

pipeline_run_id.description: Identifier of the extraction pipeline run that produced this record. Useful for batch-level debugging.

opensmile_version.description: openSMILE library version used for extraction.

x-changelog.changes: Marked deprecated; superseded by contracts/voice-features/feature-record.schema.json v2.0.0. No producer or consumer was built against v1. Schema rules unchanged. See contracts/voice-features/README.md for the migration mapping.

x-governance.note: This schema governs pseudonymous acoustic feature records only. The mapping from session_id to participant identity is held in a separate identity service and requires authorised access.
